Name: Joel, Chief of Gershom
Summary: Chief of the sons of Gershom who brought up the ark, with his brethren an hundred and thirty.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 15:7; 1 Chronicles 15:11: Chief of the sons of Gershom who brought up the ark, with his brethren an hundred and thirty.
LifeLesson: The mention of Joel in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
